title: Stakeholder synthesis & interaction tuning for Console Insights compact summary
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Overview: Design and validate a condensed Insights 'compact summary' card that surfaces cost & latency signals for per-route dashboards. This ticket captures the stakeholder synthesis session outcomes, interaction-level micro-tuning (hover states, drill-in affordances, inline filters), and final redlines for engineering handoff.

Goals:
- Reduce vertical real estate of the Insights dashboard by ~35% for teams wanting a compact overview.
- Preserve scannability for high-priority signals (latency P95, token cost, error rate).
- Ensure keyboard & screen-reader accessible drilldown affordances.

Scope (deliverables):
1) High-fidelity Figma screens for compact card (collapsed + expanded states).
2) Annotated interaction spec (hover states, focus rings, keyboard shortcuts: j/k to navigate cards).
3) Prototype link with realistic data and toggles for quantization of metrics.
4) Redline PDF and QA checklist for dev handoff.

Out of scope: A/B experimentation framework, backend metric aggregation changes (covered by ENG-5982).
comments: 2026-03-02 — Ava Martinez: Ran stakeholder synthesis workshop with PM, Eng, and Solutions teams. Key ask: make the compact card 'at-a-glance' and removable from main dashboard for teams that prioritize throughput metrics. Captured 12 pain points and 4 proposed layouts.

2026-03-04 — Maya Chen: Iteration 1 uploaded to Figma (variants A/B/C). Variant A favors iconography, Variant B favors text-first, Variant C emphasizes sparkline density. Requesting latency-focused variant to be primary for Dedicated customers.

2026-03-05 — Rohit Banerjee (Eng reviewer): Raised performance constraint — sparklines must be client-rendered and batched to avoid additional API calls. Flagged ENG-6021 as dependency for sparklines streaming endpoint.
2026-03-06 — PM feedback (Lena Ortiz): Prefer Variant B for first release; suggested swapping error-rate prominence depending on customer tier. Added label-level toggle concept for future work.

2026-03-08 — Design critique: Accessibility pass notes — ensure contrast ratio for small token-cost chips, increase hit target to 44px for inline filter chips, add aria-labels to drill chevrons. Assigned to accessibility microtask list.
2026-03-09 — Prototype QA (internal): Keyboard nav working; found focus trap when opening inline drill — resolved by adding escape handler and focus return. Updated annotations accordingly.
2026-03-11 — Legal/Security note from compliance: No sensitive data surfaced in compact card; include toggle to hide route names for anonymized screenshots. Added to release notes and design handoff.
2026-03-12 — Maya Chen: Preparing redlines and dev-ready frames. Blocker: final confirmation on microcopy for cost tooltip (PM to confirm by 2026-03-15).
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains collapsed and expanded states with dev redlines attached
Prototype demonstrates keyboard navigation and shows realistic metric samples
Accessibility checklist passed (contrast, focus order, ARIA attributes documented)
Design annotations include performance constraints and ENG dependencies
PM approval recorded on cost tooltip microcopy
